title: Siege
kicker: Delve, siege, party · defend the Seat
hook: **Vision:** when the war hits the Seat — yours or theirs — the fight becomes a **siege board**: structures, lanes of approach, occupy to possess. Not finished / not playable yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Not playable yet. You cannot open a siege stage in the current loop.
A tactical board for Seat defence or assault — buildings as actors, occupy to possess.
The capital fight focus — homeworld defence or Zomboss fortress assault.
You travel there to act; on resolve you return to the Sanctum — like delve, unlike a layer.

alsoTrue: Siege is the defend beat of farm / hunt / defend made into a stage.
Map pressure from Zomboss already ships; this page is the Seat board fantasy on top.

sections.title: Not finished / not playable yet
paras: You cannot enter a siege today. Sanctum, Lawn, World, and expeditions carry play.
Outcome will feed back to the rift when the stage ships.

sections.title: What it is (design)
paras: Defend the homeworld. Assault Zomboss’s fortress when you find it.
The fight is not only a graph node — structures matter, lanes of approach matter, possession of buildings matters.

sections.title: What it needs
paras: Interactive battles you play yourself are WIP shared muscle.
Farm / hunt / defend names why the Seat matters even before the board exists.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Defend the homeworld on the shipped map — losing it still ends the world.
Do not hunt for a siege board button yet — it is Vision.
When sieges ship, expect a return to the Sanctum after resolve.
doNote: Stop when siege ≠ any map contact. Related: [farm / hunt / defend](farm-hunt-defend).

mixUps.a: No. Not finished / not playable yet.

mixUps.q: Is every map fight a siege?
mixUps.a: No. Siege is the Seat board. Ordinary contacts hang on map / battle handoff.
No. He already acts on the shipped map. Siege is the capital-stage fantasy.
No. Delve is the dungeon crawl; siege is Seat defence/assault.
